positions.name: StructuredCalibrationRecord
positions.frame: how does the record's structured-field rendering (instrument, calibration status) hold together as a single record apart from the narrated account it summarizes?
positions.why: src-2 and src-3 share footing (animator=author=Xena ExpertGH, principal=null) and the same labeled-field format ('**Field**: value'), both flagged as unreferenced commentary rather than resolving to Quill's narrative account. Register reads both as the same flat instrument-native logbook signature, and power/relational reads both as informational, authority-ranking allocation of data into a record's slots — instrument identity and calibration status each occupying a designated field. Together they cohere as one directional read: the document's structured summary of the calibration event, distinct from src-1's first-person narrated assertion of the same event. No tension to note; the two fields are complementary parts of one record.
